title: Personal Projects
intro: A selection of projects I've built in my free time — experiments, tools, and ideas turned into working software.

projects.title: INA228 Current Profiler
projects.description: A low-cost, hassle-free current and power meter for embedded devices such as an STM32, from deep sleep to full load: nanoamps up to 2.5 A. A 20-bit INA228 with three switched shunts covers nine decades; the smart version switches the ranges on board (a comparator steps up in about 1 µs) and gives you one number over I2C or USB-serial, plus exact charge and energy. Rev D is an in-line USB-C power meter for chargers and phones: 4–48 V (USB PD 3.1), up to 5 A, CC/D± line readings, all sent to the PC over USB. Open hardware with KiCad files, firmware and an interactive 3D view.

projects.title: KMSwitch
projects.description: An open-hardware keyboard/mouse switch (KVM) for two computers, built on the RP2040. Switch with a hotkey or by moving the mouse across the screen edge — no host software, works in the BIOS, with a shared microSD drive and galvanic isolation.
